summary.notes: Illustrative reduced-cache shape only; summary values are examples.

series.quality_note: Fewer than 3600 valid ATS samples: insufficient to establish full-sol extrema.
Full-sol coverage unknown; counts or extrema times cannot establish continuous coverage.

caveat: Point measurements at the rover location during the listed sols; not current conditions and not representative of the whole region. Station coordinates are the landing site; the rover has since traversed several kilometres.

statistic_labels.extrema: Observed min/max over n_samples retained observations, not full-sol extrema.
statistic_labels.mean: Equal-weight mean of available per-sol sample means; not time-weighted.

field_caveats.coverage: Counts are retained observations per field. Null counts/spans were not cached; extrema times cannot reconstruct coverage.
field_caveats.air_temp_c: Null air means were not cached; extrema cannot reconstruct a mean.
field_caveats.quality: Instrument confidence flags not applied; no rover-heating correction. Historical sensor-local data, no forecast or safe EVA window. Wind/dust/UV/ionizing radiation unavailable.
field_caveats.relative_humidity_pct: RH is local to sensor temperature. Observed RH minimum unavailable in reduced cache; summary min remains the minimum of per-sol means. RH = 0 % samples may have been dropped by an earlier filter; RH statistics unverified.
field_caveats.legacy_filter: Cached MEDA air/pressure statistics predate physical screening; sample-level validation is unavailable offline.
